title: K-flatness of a complex of sheaves is detected on stalks
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space and $K^\bullet$ a complex of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Then $K^\bullet$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex] if and only if, for every $x\in X$, the stalk complex $K_x^\bullet$ is K-flat as a complex of modules over the ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$: tensoring it with any acyclic complex of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules gives an acyclic total complex.

mathlib_searches.query: a complex of sheaves is K-flat iff all stalk complexes are K-flat
mathlib_searches.results: Only flatness of scheme morphisms at stalk maps and flatness of individual modules; no K-flat complex theorem.
